_comment: Canonical client list rendered by ClientsCarousel.astro. Shared across FR/EN (company names don't translate). Fallback chain per client: `logo` file if present → `monogram` pill (short text). Add a `url` field to link out to the client site if desired. When the operator adds a new client, drop the logo into /public/assets/logos/ and append here — no code changes needed. See src/components/ClientsCarousel.astro.
